title: Ambani vs Adani: The BIGGEST Business Battle in India | Who Will Win?
text: You must have heard of  business battles like Coke Vs Pepsi McDonalds Vs Burger King Bill Gates Vs Steve Jobs these all were old business battles In India the biggest business  battle is going to happen maybe world's biggest business battle Adani Vs Ambani Adani and Ambani are two big Industrialists who  have been a major part of India's business landscape when we talk about the richest of India the number 1 is Mukesh Ambani and Number 2 is Gautam Adani they both are kings in  their own field and and they rarely fail when it comes to business  and entering a new business market in fact by some people they are called Kings of Monopoly because whatever market they go in  they disrupt it and become the leaders before this year they never stepped into  each other's businesses because they know the amount of impact one of them have recently they broke the unsaid rule they stepped into each other's businesses they are actually making one move each passing day which is just fueling their clash more and more everyday coming from the land of Gujarat  these 2 men are known for their vision it's not like they were growing up and they woke up one day and became a  businessman and one of the best in the country you know what they have business running  through their veins and they both know this thing if any of these lay an eye on something they'll definitely acheive it  whatever they want they'll get it due to this from a long time they have  not been entering each other's business recently Ambani broke this rule  in the rule of Chess you can only play your horse or the pawn first but Ambani in the chess of business broke the  basic rule and went ahead for Adani's queen the queen being Renewable Energy Business Adani's biggest business is  Renewable Energy Business in the last annual general  meeting in June 2021 Ambani announced Reliances Industries  entry into renewable energy sector Mukesh Ambani further announced  that Reliance will further invest $10B into renewable energy venture to build  a capacity of 100 Giga watts in next 10 years by 2030 Reliance will produce around 22% of  the total renewable energy capacity of India Adani group is currently the  biggest player in their sector infact the group has invested big  bus in the renewable energy sector the entry of India's biggest compnay reliance  in this sector will create serious competition for Adani group, with the intentions  of Reliance made public it was Gautam Adani's turn  to give it back recently Adani group announced that they are looking  to invest $20B into renewable energy exactly 50% more than Ambani Adani's capital expenditure until  2025 is in green technologies Adani's investment plans come close on the heels of similar green energy initiatives of rival Ambani Sector 2  Petroleum now you must be thinking Ambani made one move  and Adani made one, so now the battle is over, No Now when Ambani has attacked Adani's queen  then Adani obviously won't fall back Adani group decided to take this  business battle to Reliance's territories in July 2021 exactly 1 month after Ambani's announcement adani group announced it's new business venture in the petro-chemical sector Adani group has petro-chemical majors like BSF Ag and Borealis Ag of Germany  and Abu Dhabi national oil as partners petro-chemical is crown jewel of  Reliance Business Empire the Jamnagar refinery is the biggest refinery  and the petro-chemical complex in the world Adani's entry in to the petro-chemical  sector marked the formal beginning of the business battle between  the two Richest Indians because since they both are directly  attacking each other so a battle is in tow Number 3 sector  Superapp have you ever seen the game tug of war  what happens there is one team keeps pulling until the other team falls  this is what Mr. Adani did he didn't stop at petro-chemical Gautam Adani decided to take this business battle to another level and played another move against  Reliance with it's new Superapp plans those who follow Reliance's news they must know that  Reliance is working on creating an end-to-end  e-commerce solution through  Reliance retail and Jio the proposed Superapp from reliance will bring many verticals of e-commerce from online shopping to bill  payment to entertainment to groceries to medicines  to healthcare everything under 1 umbrella app something like Amazon of India but now  Adani has planned to make their own Superapp Adani Digital Labs a new company started  under the banner of Adani enterprises is currently building a Superapp for Adani group the planned Superapp will bring all consumer facing business of Adani group under 1 App with this app Adani gas and power customers will be able to pay their bills users can book tickets to fly from  one of the 7 airports controlled by Adani group Gautam Adani wants his Superapp to be the Ferrari  of the digital world these are amazing big business plans and that's our future as a country we need an  app where everything is available very easily for us the thing is whoever will launch this first they will get a starter advantage now it is to see who starts first and we all know that Jio literally entered  into market by providing their services for free so we have to see what will the schemes and what will be the discounts Adani group is willing to provide us to use their Superapp definitely something great to look  forward to for Indian customers Sector 4 is  Retail you must have heard about Reliance retail and you might know that Reliance retail is the largest retailer in India in  terms of revenue it's retail outlets offer food, groceries,apparels, footwear, toys, home improvement products electronics a lot of things apart from these physical outlets the company  also sells products on it's e-commerce channels reliance retail at this moment  is aiming for a 3x growth in the next 3-5 years and are making deeper investment to better their research design product development capabilities Now comes the twist in the story or  we can say that Adani's next move yes you're getting ir right Adani and Adani group has a presence in groceries  and ration business already Adani Wilmar you must have heard one of the oldest business of Gautam Adani's business empire which produces cooking oil and dry rations under the fortune brand lately Adani group is also opening retail stores giving giving a direct neck to neck competition to reliance retail and as I said earlier they are making Superapp so we can say that they will have the retail stores  they will provide the retail good on the Superapp too which by the way Reliance already is doing now you all must be thinking Raj bro reliance is already established they why they will fear in retail now as I said  earlier they both know that both of them have amazing business accumen and if the set  their eyes on something they will achieve it so even if Adani is starting from Scratch Ambani knows this that Adani can do a lot with the resources he has so we'll see where will our next retail   order come from in the coming years Number 5 sector News Channel Now each others main business is done  retail is done Superapp is done now what is left Ambani has one business that people don't talk much about but actually it is very big and important business which is media in his $200B business empire a big chunk of contribution is done by the media i'll tell you how you've heard about Viacom 18 and News 18 through which reliance operated over 53 channel in India 53  YES and those 53 channels include channels like  Colors, MTV, VH1, News 18 and many more these are the biggest channel in India we all know how impactfull Network 18 is when it comes to the media Network 18 is most watched news network in India and it owns 16 news  channels in 15 different Indian languages recently Adani group shocked the Indian business  circle when the group announced it has brought in Sanjay Pugalia, a senior journalist as the CEO  and editor-in-chief for Adani's new media venture Sanjay has previously worked with T he Quint, CNBC, India Today, Zee News and there are rumour in the media that  Adani group may acquire Zee News or NDTV interestingly the appointment of Sanjay Pugalis conceeds with the mess in Zee media right now hinting us that this might be just a rumour and  Adani is stepping into news business as well giving direct competition to Ambani in the news sector as well so this battle has become a game of chess where Adani is playing move after move  and building up the tension of this game in this tug of war you might feel that Adani is the only one pushing Ambani right now but is it as we all know Mukesh Ambani knows how to disrupt the market when he does it he makes sure the sound of disruption is heard by the whole world we saw it with the  JIO and this guy has proved it again and again with the 2 richest Indian going face ton face in the petro-chemical, renewable energy, e-commerce, retail and media sector is it safe to say that  Ambani Vs Adani is going to be the biggest business battle in India a battle of similar magnitude has never seen or being witnessed in Our Country. the battle will probably shape India's business landscape in coming years, this is just the beginning the real battle is yet to begin let me know in the comment section who do  you think will win the battle Adani? or Ambani? which team are you supporting  Team Adani or Team Ambani?
